topic: What happens if you walk ten thousand steps every day?
title: What daily walking does
hook: What happens if you walk ten thousand steps?

beats.label: 2K
beats.line: Just two thousand steps outside can already lift your mood a little.

beats.label: 5K
beats.line: By five thousand steps, your heart gets a light workout.

beats.label: 7K
beats.line: Around seven thousand steps in, sleep quality often starts to improve too.

beats.label: 10K
beats.line: Ten thousand steps can burn solid calories, though benefits can level off.

end.line: How many steps did you take today?

description: How a daily walk can help your heart, mood, sleep and calories burned.

facts.claim: Physical activity like walking can help boost mood.
Regular walking strengthens the heart and can improve cardiovascular fitness.
Regular physical activity such as walking is linked to better sleep quality.
Walking burns calories, and research suggests many health benefits plateau somewhere between about 7,000 and 10,000 steps a day.
